description: This file defines the ProviderMigrationService class for managing OAuth provider registration, specifically for Google Calendar integration within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for validation, creation, and retrieval of OAuth provider records, interacting with system configurations, database, and external modules.

classes.name: ProviderMigrationService
classes.description: Handles creation, validation, and retrieval of OAuth providers for Google Calendar integration as part of calendar sync migration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes database and logger dependencies for the service.

methods.name: validateProviderRequirements
methods.description: Validates system requirements for provider creation, checking for module availability and database table existence.

methods.name: createOrGetExternalOAuthProvider
methods.description: Creates a new OAuth provider for Google Calendar or retrieves an existing one, supporting dry-run mode.

methods.name: findExistingGoogleOAuthProvider
methods.description: Queries database to find an existing Google OAuth provider with calendar scope.
